news.title: New major risk - Earnings quality
news.body: The company has a high level of non-cash earnings. Accrual ratio: 36% This is considered a major risk. Non-cash earnings can arise from many different things. However, if a company consistently has a high level of non-cash earnings, it may be a sign that they are recognizing revenue from customers before the full value of the sales are received as cash or they are not depreciating the value of their assets appropriately. These are practices that inflate earnings, while not providing a similar increase to cash flows. Companies in some select industries naturally have a high level of non-cash earnings and it is not a major concern. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.80 (vs ₹0.85 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.80 (down from ₹0.85 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹3.08b (up 18% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹379.9m (down 5.8% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 12% (down from 16% in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 10% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 3% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.

news.title: Infomedia and Networking Private Limited acquired 56.88% stake in Den Budaun Cable Network Private Limited from DEN Networks Limited (NSEI:DEN).
news.body:
Infomedia and Networking Private Limited acquired 56.88% stake in Den Budaun Cable Network Private Limited from DEN Networks Limited (NSEI:DEN) on November 26, 2025. A cash consideration will be paid by Infomedia and Networking Private Limited for 41,388 equity shares. Infomedia and Networking Private Limited acquired Den Fateh Marketing Private Limited, Den Budaun Cable Network Private Limited and Mahadev Den Cable Network Limited for consideration of INR 30.

As of March 31, 2025, Den Budaun Cable Network Private Limited reported total common equity of INR 0.58 million.

Infomedia and Networking Private Limited completed the acquisition of 56.88% stake in Den Budaun Cable Network Private Limited from DEN Networks Limited (NSEI:DEN) on November 26, 2025.
